title: Train, validation and test; cross-validation, and the split that respects time

videos.script: A decision tree with no limits learns the churn data perfectly. {{perfect}} Every training row, right. Then it meets six months it never saw, and it loses money. It does worse than a model that always says stay. {{worse}} That gap is why a model is judged on rows it did not learn from. This lesson is about choosing those rows. {{choosing}} Cut at random, and the folds of a rare class come out uneven. {{stratified}} Cut at random, and the same subscriber sits on both sides. Whether that matters depends on the question. {{groups}} And cut at random, and September teaches the model about August. {{time}} The model will be used forward in time. So it is tested forward in time. Month by month, its value moves. In September it doubles, the month the price went up. {{walk}} By the end, you have four questions to ask of any split. And one score you can trust. {{end}}
